records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Mia,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Group
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *North Group* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Positive, engaged admin: first_project reached day 1 and 1 invite sent; customer replied unprompted that it's "starting to click" [email:99fcb44a], responding to [email:e4b39aca]. No tickets, no blockers, 8 days left. Momentum suggests likely unaided activation, though starter/solo adoption can stall.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click, and thanks for the update. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step that usually makes it stick is getting your team's real work into that project alongside the teammate you invited.

Want me to help you map out that first batch of tasks? Happy to do it over a 15-minute call this week or by email, whichever is easier.

Best,
Priya
